title: On The Lawn Cottage Seaside, FL
meta_description: Recent construction on the Seaside Croquet Lawn, 6 bedrooms, 7.5 baths, custom-designed family home with designer touches and furniture throughout. Four Floors, elevator, tower with slight Gulf views.
description_expanded: Description39 WAKULA LANE4 KINGS, 1 QUEEN, 2 BUNKS, 1 KING SLEEPER SOFA (sleeps 16) Please be advised that there is a construction staging area located on the left of the croquet lawn for Seaside improvements, we apologize for this inconvenience. Construction completion date is January 2026.Prime Seaside Location on the Croquet LawnWelcome to On the Lawn, a stunning new six-bedroom luxury home perfectly positioned in the heart of Seaside, Florida, directly overlooking the tranquil Seaside Croquet Lawn. This serene green space stretches out just beyond your front porch, offering peaceful park views and a rare sense of openness in Seaside. Located only a five-minute walk to the beach and just steps from pools, playgrounds, and tennis courts, this home places you at the center of Seaside living while maintaining a quiet, refined atmosphere.The beautifully furnished front porch features classic rockers and a charming bed swing—an ideal spot for morning coffee, afternoon reading, or unwinding in the evening as the sun sets over the lawn.Designer Living & Entertaining SpacesStep inside to an expansive first floor designed for gathering and entertaining. The open-concept layout seamlessly connects a generous living area, formal dining space, gourmet kitchen, and a dedicated bar area. Designer furnishings and elevated finishes are featured throughout, creating a refined yet welcoming environment.A secondary living nook near the entrance is thoughtfully designed as a family game space, complete with a built-in corner bench and table—perfect for board games and relaxed nights in. The main living room offers ample seating and a large 75" LG Smart TV, making it ideal for movie nights or watching the big game together.At the heart of the home, the dining area comfortably seats eight beneath a striking designer chandelier, with additional seating for three at the adjacent bar. The bar area includes a beverage fridge, wine fridge, ice maker, and a convenient half bath—perfect for entertaining.Gourmet Kitchen & Butler’s PantryThe chef’s kitchen is both stunning and functional, featuring top-of-the-line appliances and generous workspace. Highlights include a six-burner stove with griddle, a 66-inch-wide refrigerator and freezer, a 44-inch Galley sink, and a large center island with seating for three. Just beyond the kitchen, a spacious walk-in butler’s pantry offers additional storage and prep space, making hosting effortless.Bonus Ground-Level Suite & Outdoor AmenitiesBelow the main level, a bonus ground floor functions as a private studio-style retreat. This space includes a king daybed, mounted 43" LG Smart TV, full bathroom with washer and dryer, refrigerator/freezer, private outdoor access, and elevator entry—perfect for extended family or guests seeking additional privacy.Outside, the rear of the home offers private parking for two vehicles, a gas grill for outdoor cooking, and an outdoor shower—ideal for rinsing off after a day at the beach.Dual Primary Suites & Laundry LoungeThe second floor is home to two luxurious king primary suites, known as the East King and West King. The East King primary is oversized and features a mounted 49" LG Smart TV, a spa-inspired bathroom with dual vanities, a deep soaking tub beneath a chandelier, a glass-enclosed rain shower with multiple shower heads, and a large walk-in closet.The West King primary overlooks the Croquet Lawn and includes a shaded private balcony with a rocker—perfect for morning coffee with park views. This suite also offers a mounted 49" LG Smart TV, walk-in closet, and a private bath with dual vanities and a glass-enclosed rain shower.Also on this level is a jumbo laundry room complete with sink, counter space, ironing station, and windows with views—ideal for longer stays or multi-generational vacations.Guest Bedrooms & Family-Friendly LayoutThe third floor offers four additional bedrooms designed for comfort and flexibility. Two king bedrooms feature private ensuite baths and mounted 49" LG Smart TVs, with one offering park views and the other including a desk area ideal for working remotely. A queen bedroom also faces the park and includes its own ensuite bathroom with a glass-enclosed shower.The sixth bedroom is a kids’ favorite, featuring two sets of twin bunk beds that sleep four. This room connects to an adjacent full bathroom with a large glass-enclosed walk-in shower.Rooftop Tower with Panoramic ViewsAt the top of the home, the private tower offers tabletop bar seating for two and 360-degree panoramic views of Seaside’s rooftops, the surrounding wetlands, and even a glimpse of the Gulf. This elevated perch is the perfect place to enjoy sunset cocktails, take in the coastal breeze, and savor unforgettable Seaside evenings.On the Lawn delivers the ultimate Seaside luxury experience—combining exceptional design, thoughtful amenities, and one of the most desirable locations in town. From park-front living to rooftop sunsets, every detail is designed to elevate your Seaside, Florida vacation.* 5-night minimum Summer 2026; 5 nights Spring & Spring Break; 4-night minimum Thanksgiving, Christmas, & New Year's Eve. 3-night minimum for Fall & Winter. 7 night minimum SAT to SAT Summer 2027. Must be 25 years of age to rent and sign registration. Please be advised that On The Lawn is equipped with an active front door Ring bell.FEATURESApproximately 4,500 square feet with private elevator accessSeaside Private Residential Beach Access: Tupelo Pavilion — the largest stretch of private residential beach on 30A5-minute walk (352 yards) to beach accessElevator for guest use servicing all levelsFour king primary bedroom suites, each with a private ensuite bathroomJumbo laundry room ideal for extended stays and large groups75" LG Smart TV in the main living roomChef’s kitchen: Expansive layout with a large butler’s pantry, high-end appliances, premium knives, and cookwareDedicated bar area: Wine fridge, beverage fridge, and ice makerTower with slight Gulf views and panoramic Seaside rooftop scenerySmart TVs throughout: Every bedroom except the bunk room (7 Smart TVs total)Outdoor amenities: Enclosed outdoor shower and gas grillCommunity amenities access: 3 swimming pools, 5 clay tennis courts, 3 pickleball courts (court fees apply), and a fitness centerWelcome tote with two beach towels, a complimentary bottle of wine, and two complimentary rental bikes for pickup at the Seaside Transit AuthorityPersonalized service throughout your stay with starter amenities providedParking & golf cart policy: Private driveway parking for two vehicles, plus two additional parking passes issued. A golf cart is considered a vehicle. Golf carts for non-homeowners visiting Seaside are prohibited. Special circumstances and medical needs require an approved golf cart permit.No pets allowedSTR23-001965
